notes:
Ethereum mainnet (chainId 1), official standard evm_project route, paired with IMD at pool.pairedCurrency. src/LaunchToken.sol:LaunchToken has a nonpayable constructor with no arguments and mints 1,000,000,000 EMVO (10^27 base units, 18 decimals) once to its deployer, which must be the official ProjectFactory. Plain ERC-20: no later mint, token admin, upgradeability, pause, blacklist, transfer tax, rebase, staking, custom vesting, required burn or AI financial authority. No application contracts or initialization calls. The factory supplies the LP, official Swarm MerkleDistributor and initialization-only PoolInitializationGuard; the guard has no swap callbacks.
Required effective economics: economics.poolBps=8600, allocating 860,000,000 EMVO (86%) to the pool; 100,000,000 EMVO (10%) to the official Swarm distributor, comprising 20,000,000 for accepted workers and 80,000,000 for paired seats under official admission rules; 40,000,000 EMVO (4%) to remainderTo=0x1C651928150DADDDA9C2C040a9D4901d862f8eC4. That address must also be the issuer, actual launch-payment wallet and launch-payer trading-fee beneficiary. A separate Report payer is not the issuer. These notes do not configure economics or grant token privileges; admission must enforce the resolved policy and allocation.
Required standard opening cap: 2,500 IMD, with effective opening price derived by the official deployer from pinned policy and currency ordering; the manifest sqrtPriceX96 is the legacy input. Liquidity is seeded with launch tokens only. Admission fee=3000 and tickSpacing=60 are distinct from the live pool trading fee. Required standard LaunchFees terms: 1.25% per trade, comprising 1% to the issuing launch payer and 0.25% to the official IMD fee recipient; anyone may claim for those beneficiaries. Verify live terms at Check. The opening cap is not a launch charge or backing promise.
Unresolved launch blockers: exact official policy version/digest, ProjectFactory and LaunchFees addresses, resolved distributor and protocol fee recipient, LP custody/powers, actual launch charge/payee and gas terms, and authenticated Check quote/binding are not supplied. Check must display effective allocation, IMD address, supply, opening price and all fee terms. Bind the actual quote to this manifest, accepted artifact hashes, resolved chain/policy/economics/payer and launch/intent.json SHA-256 a5887650c8227315d01b6dc521d96ed784e5a5d13f68cfe50e5e864f01a01203, preserving quote identity, digest and expiry. A local hash is not quote authentication. No quote or binding is claimed; payment/deployment remain blocked pending official evidence. Do not silently change chain, pair, kind, supply, recipients, allocation or fee terms. If the official route requires a custom project contract, report that blocker without adding one or switching kind.
Gas responsibilities: the issuer funds approval/payment transaction gas in ETH unless explicitly sponsored; the official deployer transaction sender pays factory deployment gas, with sponsorship/reimbursement and inclusion in launch charges disclosed by the quote; traders and claim submitters fund their transaction gas unless sponsored. A free Check or earlier Report is not security certification.
EmberEvo is an independent IMD Ember World ecosystem token. Planned utility: crypto token/NFT research discovery and future Genesis PEPE paid mint. A later Genesis contract would atomically take an exact EMVO payment to the issuing wallet and mint an NFT, without required burn; the owner may freely use receipts. This launch implements or deploys no Genesis, research service, website, treasury/vault or extra product contract. No yield, dividends, redemption, backing or price promise.
